scenes.text: Item 1: which unit is sensible for measuring the length of a pencil? Let us think carefully. Use centimetres for shorter lengths and metres for longer lengths. The answer is cm. Great work!
Item 2: which unit is sensible for measuring the length of a door? Let us think carefully. Use centimetres for shorter lengths and metres for longer lengths. The answer is m. Great work!
Item 3: which unit is sensible for measuring the length of a textbook? Let us think carefully. Use centimetres for shorter lengths and metres for longer lengths. The answer is cm. Great work!
Item 4: which unit is sensible for measuring the length of a football pitch? Let us think carefully. Use centimetres for shorter lengths and metres for longer lengths. The answer is m. Great work!
